question: For each reproducible regression-catalog entry, how quickly does adamic-fuzz report a disagreement once the entry's fault is re-applied?

method.command: adamic-fuzz -root <patched worktree> -work <own directory> -seed 1 -count 2000 -parallel 4 -shrink=false -v, GOFLAGS=-trimpath, one process per run, stopped 3 seconds after the first finding line, at 2,000 seeds, or at 15 minutes
method.seconds: wall seconds from launching adamic-fuzz, which includes building the checkout's adamic command and runtime, to the finding's verdict line
method.seeds: reported_seed is the first finding printed; with four workers, lower seeds can still be running, so lowest_finding_seed is the lowest seed that was a finding among the seeds judged before the run stopped, and every seed below it was judged and agreed
method.shrink: adamic-fuzz -root <patched worktree> -seed <reported seed> -count 1 -parallel 1 (shrink on), with the generator that found it
method.applicability: git apply --check of each catalog patch on the pinned main, the same check check.py makes; check.py itself reads /proc and nproc and does not run on macOS, so it was not run
method.leak_pass: This Mac's ASan has no leak detection, so each generator's internal/fuzz/run.go was patched in its scratch worktree only (uncommitted) to ignore a leak run whose stderr says detect_leaks is not supported on this platform. Heap-use-after-free, buffer overflows and UBSan still report on macOS; leaks are not covered by these numbers.
method.cap_note: overlapped_runs names the other runs of this study that shared the machine with a run, and the machine carried other agents' work throughout (load averages below), so seconds are noisy; seeds are the stable number.

targets.main_note: origin/main moved from e8ba3d5d to f8013f0b (the fixes-3 landing) while the first runs were being set up; every run was restarted on f8013f0b. Entries 08 and 12 no longer apply there, so they are recorded as needing a refresh and were also run, as a supplement, on e8ba3d5d, where they apply, against that commit's own control.
targets.later_main: origin/main kept moving (b8fb957a, then 39638d9e) and this branch is based on origin/area/developer-tools 752f4531; applicability was not rechecked on those later commits
targets.scenes_note: The scenes generator ran against origin/main 39638d9e. 02 and 09 apply there unchanged. 08 does not: inside the hunk the patch removes, main now calls l.acceptsUndefined(node) where the patch has comparedWithUndefined(node), so the patch's copy of that one removed line was changed to match (verify/catalog/08-narrowed-number-field-39638d9e.patch), same intent (remove the declared maybe-field read before trusting the narrowing).

area.note: generate.go identical to 89e586e3b, the tip when this run began; the tip moved during setup (it gained adamic-reduce)

i16.note: adds the shared-slices, ownership and overrides features on top of integration 16, with the same judge

latest.note: the area tip at the end: it merged the i16 families and a new undefined-numbers family; run only on the entries no earlier generator found

scenes.note: origin/area/developer-tools 3f904d53 plus the liveness and field-representation scenes (internal/fuzz/liveness.go, field_representation.go), each on a random stream of its own; run on the three entries no earlier generator found

build_flags.go_flags: -trimpath on every go build (GOFLAGS=-trimpath for the checkout builds adamic-fuzz makes)
build_flags.native_flags: native.Flags(Sanitize: true) of the generator's tree: ASan and UBSan, as the oracle's sanitized build
build_flags.load_note: vm.loadavg before and after each run is in that run's record
